objective: Repair the v1 live-corpus launchability boundary with compact reproducible commitments, structural de-duplication, complete packet identity binding, coherent prelaunch staging, and unchanged Plan Assurance semantics.

base_packet.inheritance_rule: Every v1 semantic field and every unchanged v1 core artifact remains authoritative unless this overlay explicitly replaces it. Omission from this overlay never deletes a v1 requirement.

authority.next_boundary: A fresh trial controller must perform deterministic local staging, freeze exact payload and execution manifests, then receive one fresh sender-attested v1.1 launch authority.

preserved_method_semantics.base_dispatch_pairs: exactly LOCAL_EXPECTATION_MODELER plus OPEN_DISCOVERY_RESEARCHER for each of the four pilot families
preserved_method_semantics.base_dispatch_initial_view: both base roles receive strict role-specific EXPECTATION_PACKET envelopes only; detailed target Plan assertions and controller-only CAPABILITY_SLICE_MANIFEST bytes remain withheld until the inherited lock boundary
preserved_method_semantics.conditional_failure_worker: at most one FAILURE_EVIDENCE_RESEARCHER per family when the controller-derived adequacy trigger fires; same bounded web research tools as the open researcher
preserved_method_semantics.creative_external_discovery: mandatory open exploration with variable depth; no fixed URL quota; adequate failure evidence, alternatives, applicability, currentness, and unsearched limits remain explicit
preserved_method_semantics.research_adequacy_recovery: at most one conditional failure-evidence worker per family, only when controller-derived adequacy triggers fire
preserved_method_semantics.frontier_stop: two successive targeted passes add no critical or major obligation or material semantic revision and leave no unresolved adequacy gap

structural_map.complete_source_population_binding: source physical and classification roots plus class counts
structural_map.noncanonical_populations: committed by deterministic class roots and counts; never semantically reread

identity.compression: identity or one RFC1952 gzip member only when declared by an artifact budget manifest

prelaunch_sequence: freeze packet identity and confirm future run root absent
capture stable-double-scan SOURCE_SNAPSHOT and live PROTECTED_BEFORE while run root is absent
create the sole audit-local run root under deterministic local-staging authority; no model, research, network, or semantic worker

build the whole-corpus structural map, named surface ledger, capability slices, exact expectation packets, canary registry, external-transmission manifest, and semantic execution envelope deterministically
revalidate source and protected invariance; freeze the exact v1.1 LAUNCH_REQUEST
receive and live-validate one fresh Codex collaboration sender attestation
write TRUSTED_LAUNCH_CAPABILITY only inside AUTHORITY/ under the sole run root
atomically create the one-use marker inside AUTHORITY/ before the first external action
after the complete live scan returns, acquire fresh platform time and validate PREDISPATCH_FRESHNESS_RECEIPT within two seconds of the immediate dispatch boundary
dispatch only exact hash-bound clean-context worker payloads

authority_contract.trusted_capability_location: AUTHORITY/TRUSTED_LAUNCH_CAPABILITY.json beneath the sole run root
authority_contract.launch_authority_location: AUTHORITY/LAUNCH_AUTHORITY.json beneath the sole run root
authority_contract.single_use_marker_location: AUTHORITY/LAUNCH_AUTHORITY_USED.json beneath the sole run root
authority_contract.deleted_or_missing_prior_marker_terminal: SAFETY_ABORT when a prior consumed generation is otherwise evidenced
authority_contract.required_live_validation_entrypoint: validate_live_launch_chain followed by validate_immediate_predispatch_freshness; omission or mismatch of expected context, live sender metadata, initial platform-observed time, exact packet/repository/run roots, live packet core, live-rebuilt canonical source index, live-rebuilt current protected receipt, budget contract, predispatch inventory, exact root control files, post-validation platform time, or immediate dispatch-boundary time fails closed
authority_contract.predispatch_freshness_receipt_location: PREDISPATCH_FRESHNESS_RECEIPT.json beneath the sole run root and charged to the predeclared reserve
authority_contract.predispatch_freshness_claim: platform-observed immediate dispatch boundary only; it does not claim that the external action occurred
authority_contract.predispatch_fuse_enforcement: root-backed typed ARTIFACT_BUDGET_MANIFEST must inventory every existing run-root file, bind the live protected-current receipt, stream-validate decoded and shard limits, preserve terminal reserve, and pass before dispatch
authority_contract.incremental_and_terminal_fuse_enforcemen: controller revalidates budgets before and after every committed artifact write; final ARTIFACT_BUDGET_MANIFEST and protected AFTER receipt are mandatory before terminal
authority_contract.single_use_marker_creation: O_CREAT|O_EXCL, no-follow, single-link regular file beneath run-root AUTHORITY; any preexisting or partial marker blocks without cleanup

semantic_isolation_contract.allowed_inputs: exact hash-bound strict EXPECTATION_PACKET envelopes listed as model-visible in the frozen transmission manifest; controller-only capability slices are forbidden before the inherited lock boundary
semantic_isolation_contract.limitation: Codex collaboration roles share a host filesystem; this trial uses clean history, no-tool role contracts, payload allowlists and canaries but does not claim OS-enforced read isolation. Any observed out-of-packet read invalidates the affected result and blocks scale inference.

semantic_artifact_normalization.GRAPH_MERGE_RECEIPT: CAPABILITY_OBLIGATION_GRAPH graph payload and contribution-edge hashes

schemas.unchanged_semantic_schemas: inherited from exact v1 base core manifest

budgets.per_family_inherited: exact v1 per-family token, context, operation, wall, retry, 8 MiB and 128-file ceilings
budgets.accounting: Every physical regular file, descriptor, shard, marker, receipt, summary and terminal artifact counts once physically. Every preterminal run-root file must be enumerated exactly once in the budget manifest; the manifest itself is counted from its live bytes; exact later terminal paths are bounded by the preserved reserve. Every decoded logical byte counts once logically. No support/baseline exemption. Producer claims never substitute for lstat, streaming decode or recomputed hashes.
budgets.terminal_accounting_sequence: Freeze the preterminal manifest with exact listed files, its live self size, exact terminal-reserve paths, and the PROTECTED_AFTER run-root population binding; later terminal files may consume only that reserve and no unlisted path is allowed. The final caller verifies live run-root enumeration without writing a self-referential receipt.

ready_meaning: Packet and harness representation launch readiness only. It grants no launch, Plan-quality, product, buildability, runtime, governance, or implementation claim.
